name: tracer
description: Code intelligence for Claude Code: every file Claude reads, edits, or searches arrives with its declarations, its callers, its git history, and the project docs it has not read yet.

tracerOnly.title: Claude reads code only through tracer
tracerOnly.description: Claude can't read or search this project with grep, cat, find, or git blame. It uses tracer instead, so every read comes with the file's callers, history, and docs.
